title: [GMCP 203.001.05] Interoperability and quality: Normative requirements ledger and standards drift
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-001-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: A machine-readable requirements ledger covers every applicable MCP 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 MUST, SHOULD, error, deprecation, security rule, official extension, and implementation claim. Every row traces to an owner, production path, positive and negative test, evidence artifact, and disposition; automated upstream drift detection fails closed on an unclassified change. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
